## IRT Announces Dates for Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 14, 2026


PHILADELPHIA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Independence Realty Trust, Inc. (“IRT”) (NYSE: IRT) announces the release date and conference call details related to its third quarter 2026 financial results.


**Details:**


Results Release Date: Monday, November 2, 2026, after the market closes


Conference Call Date and Time: Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time


Live Webcast:[https://investors.irtliving.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.irtliving.com%2Fcorporate-profile%2F%3F_gl%3D1*f0i8mi*_gcl_au*MzkyOTQ1ODI4LjE3Mzg2MTc2Nzg.*_ga*MTM1MjU3Mjc3OS4xNzM4NjE3Njc4*_ga_733QN6EE45*MTc0MzAxMjM2OC40Ni4xLjE3NDMwMTI1ODAuMTEuMC4w&esheet=54620668&newsitemid=20261013138146&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.irtliving.com&index=1&md5=850ec18917807dd341a16cb1358f4855)


**Replay Information:**


Shortly after the live conference call concludes, a webcast replay will be available on IRT’s Investor Relations website,[https://investors.irtliving.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.irtliving.com%2Fcorporate-profile%2F%3F_gl%3D1*f0i8mi*_gcl_au*MzkyOTQ1ODI4LjE3Mzg2MTc2Nzg.*_ga*MTM1MjU3Mjc3OS4xNzM4NjE3Njc4*_ga_733QN6EE45*MTc0MzAxMjM2OC40Ni4xLjE3NDMwMTI1ODAuMTEuMC4w&esheet=54620668&newsitemid=20261013138146&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.irtliving.com&index=2&md5=1879da8411d558093f053bf48bfa1569) .


**About IRT:**


Independence Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: IRT), an S&P 400 MidCap Company, is a real estate investment trust that owns and operates multifamily communities, across non-gateway U.S. markets. IRT’s investment strategy is focused on gaining scale near major employment centers within key amenity-rich submarkets that offer good school districts and high-quality retail. IRT’s main objective is to provide attractive risk-adjusted returns to shareholders through diligent portfolio management, strong operational performance, and a consistent return on capital through distributions and capital appreciation. More information is available at[www.irtliving.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.irtliving.com&esheet=54620668&newsitemid=20261013138146&lan=en-US&anchor=www.irtliving.com&index=3&md5=ddbd56fccb728ff35d97ca93772bb285) .
